title: US and Denmark reach deal over Greenland after Trump annexation threats
description: Trump says the agreement will give the US "permanent control over security, and all other needs, in Greenland", though specifics have not been confirmed by Danish officials.

title: 'I'm telling the truth': Earl Spencer defends Diana book claims about Charles in BBC interview
description: Princess Diana's brother tells the BBC's Laura Kuenssberg that "we'll forget her soon enough" were "exactly" the words used by the then-Prince of Wales.

title: Watch: Diana's brother says Charles 'went ballistic' in phone call after her death
description: Earl Spencer spoke exclusively with the BBC's Laura Kuenssberg about claims he has made in a new book.

title: Billionaire Man United owner says he has lost confidence in the UK
description: Ineos founder Sir Jim Ratcliffe tells the BBC he thinks the country is "on the slide" and calls for more investment in the North Sea.

title: Google's Gemini AI hacked three companies in security test
description: The AI model accessed the internet and guessed credentials to three websites, a Google official told the BBC.

title: Trump says he is banning CNN and Politico from White House
description: The US president has had a tense and fiery relationship with the US media throughout his political career.

title: Parents could lose benefits or face prison for child's crimes, minister says
description: The reforms to Parenting Orders could also see parents losing benefits, Jake Richards MP told the Times.

title: A four-minute warning isn't enough: Russia's new relentless missile tactics exhaust Kyiv residents
description: Increasingly frequent and ferocious attacks on the Ukrainian capital have left many on edge.

title: Earl Spencer's Diana book opens old wounds royals would rather forget
description: Many of the Royal Family's current troubles can be traced back to the aftermath of the then Princess of Wales' death.
